title: Pinned tensor exchange on a single complex
statement: Choose derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. For schemes X, S, X', T [def-pc-scheme], morphisms f:X→S, f':X'→T, g:T→S, v:X'→X with v≫f=f'≫g, and an O_X-module G, assume tensor pullback along g and v is additive [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let εg and εv be the left-derived counits pinned by exists_derivedPullbackComposition [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Let cg:Lg*(f*G[0])→(g*f*G)[0] and cv:Lv*(G[0])→(v*G)[0] be their components followed by the localized singleMapHomologicalComplex comparisons. Then cg ≫ single(beta) ≫ canonicalSingleDirectImageMap f' (v*G) = Lg*(canonicalSingleDirectImageMap f G) ≫ schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g v h (G[0]) ≫ Rf'*(cv), where beta is the specified tensor moduleBaseChangeMap [lem-weil-pbc-module-base-change-map-open-restriction] and the single direct-image comparisons are canonical [lem-pc-canonical-single-direct-image-comparison]. No flatness or invertibility is assumed.

proof.text: Use canonicalSingleBaseChangeComparison for the arbitrary commutative square and G. Expand canonicalSinglePullbackMap as the pinned tensor comparison followed by the single of the adjunction-preserving tensor-to-ordinary isomorphism.

Prove naturality of canonicalSingleDirectImageMap along the tensor-to-ordinary v-pullback isomorphism from naturality of the right-derived unit and inverse single-complex comparison. Postcompose the tensor square with the derived direct image of the single of that isomorphism. Cancel the source tensor-to-ordinary comparison with its inverse, use the ordinary comparison identity, and cancel the postcomposed isomorphism. Only isomorphisms of ordinary pullback functors are cancelled.

theorem tensorSingleBaseChangeSquare
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ T)
    (g : T ⟶ S) (v : X' ⟶ X) (h : v ≫ f = f' ≫ g)
    [(tensorPullback g).Additive] [(tensorPullback v).Additive] (G : X.Modules) :
    let εg := (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
      exists_derivedPullbackComposition.{u, w})) g
    let εv := (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
      exists_derivedPullbackComposition.{u, w})) v
    let cg := εg.app ((HomotopyCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj ((pushforward f).obj G)) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
        ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
          (tensorPullback g) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).hom.app ((pushforward f).obj G)))
    let cv := εv.app ((HomotopyCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
        ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
          (tensorPullback v) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).hom.app G))
    cg ≫ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) 0).map
          (moduleBaseChangeMap f f' g v h G) ≫
        canonicalSingleDirectImageMap f' ((tensorPullback v).obj G) =
      (derivedPullback g).map (canonicalSingleDirectImageMap f G) ≫
        schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g v h ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ≫
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map cv
